name: Butterfly Soup 2
source:
Butterfly Soup 2 is a sequel to [url=/v21875]Butterfly Soup[/url], a romantic sports visual novel about four LGBT+ Asian-American teens playing baseball and falling in love. 

Set a few months after the events of the original story, the game switches between the perspectives of Diya, Noelle, Akarsha, and Min-seo as they navigate high school life in the San Francisco Bay Area.

[From [url=https://fluorescent-jay-d9e.notion.site/Butterfly-Soup-2-b09c63b06e1f46e1a04dd639fb1ecf31]press kit[/url]]
translation:
《蝴蝶汤2》是《蝴蝶汤》的续集。[url=/v21875]蝴蝶汤[/url]是一部浪漫的体育视觉小说，讲述了四名LGBT+ 亚裔美国青少年打棒球和坠入爱河的故事。

游戏设定在原版故事发生几个月后，在Diya、Noelle、Akarsha和Min-seo的视角之间切换，讲述他们在旧金山湾区的高中生活。

[来自[url=https://fluorescent-jay-d9e.notion.site/Butterfly-Soup-2-b09c63b06e1f46e1a04dd639fb1ecf31]新闻资料袋[/url]]
